components.css: .ds-nav{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:25px;height:39px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--line);background:var(--paper);color:var(--ink);font:600 15px/1.6 Manrope,sans-serif}.ds-nav details{position:relative}.ds-nav summary{cursor:pointer;list-style:none}.ds-nav a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none}.ds-nav a:hover{text-decoration:underline;text-underline-offset:5px}.ds-dropdown{position:absolute;top:28px;left:-20px;min-width:180px;padding:14px 22px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--line);box-shadow:0 8px 16px #292d2810;z-index:20}.ds-dropdown a{display:block;padding:8px 0;font-weight:400}.ds-nav a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--burgundy);outline-offset:4px}.ds-nav summary:focus-visible{outline:2px solid var(--burgundy);outline-offset:4px}

narrative.overview:
The visual authority is the owner's existing [Shopify storefront](https://shop.maplefurnishers.com), inspected on 25 October 2026. This is source-preservation work for an initial custom storefront, not an approved new visual concept. The cream canvas, burgundy identity, original Maple logo, workshop footage and green furniture category imagery carry that authority forward.

This document records the implementation in `apps/web/styles/storefront.css`, `apps/web/components/` and `apps/web/app/page.tsx`. It merges the earlier visual-reference notes with implemented measurements. A first-viewport desktop comparison supports the preserved header and hero composition; it does not establish full template parity. The mobile layout is an implemented adaptation whose exact equivalence to Shopify remains unproven. The current full-page captures are `.impeccable/review/desktop.png` and `.impeccable/review/mobile.png`; they are review evidence, not a parity certification.
keyCharacteristics: Cream surfaces with burgundy identity and actions.
Serif headings paired with restrained sans-serif interface text.
Original furniture media with generous image areas and minimal card chrome.
Rounded imagery paired with square buttons, fields and category tabs.

rules.name: The Incumbent Authority Rule
rules.body: Resolve visual questions against the existing Shopify site and its original assets; do not treat this initial recreation as permission to redesign it.

rules.name: The Media Color Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original media's colors. Do not recolor product photographs or replace source art with generated substitutes to match a token palette.

rules.name: The Logo Asset Rule
rules.body: Preserve the original Maple logo asset in the header. The existing text-rendered footer mark is an implementation detail, not evidence of exact source-logo parity.

rules.name: The Reference Check Rule
rules.body: Check desktop and mobile against their own incumbent references; a desktop match does not prove mobile parity or the rest of the site's templates.

rules.name: The Visible Focus Rule
rules.body: Interactive controls retain the implemented 2px burgundy outline with 4px offset on keyboard focus; do not remove it to mimic a screenshot.

dos: Do preserve the existing Maple identity, original media and source artwork proportions.
Do use the implemented cream, burgundy, Manrope and Newsreader vocabulary consistently.
Do keep keyboard focus, dialog labels, image alternatives and video controls usable.
Do compare each breakpoint and template with its own incumbent reference before claiming parity.
Do keep preview catalogue and checkout limitations visible and accurate.
donts: Don't invent a new visual world or treat unverified implementation details as approved brand changes.
Don't crop baked-in promotional text or mismatch a banner's destination with its message.
Don't describe the mobile adaptation or complete storefront as an exact verified Shopify reproduction.
Don't claim live Keeri stock, completed payment integration or production readiness from visual review.
